section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis procedures for a study examining relationships between education, age, BMI, body appreciation, body dissatisfaction, and subjective happiness. The analysis was conducted in three steps: first testing a hypothesized model in the larger US sample, then improving the model with additional paths, and finally fitting the final model to both US and non-US samples using multi-group analysis. Mplus 6.11 was used for path analyses with robust estimation methods and standard fit indices (CFI, TLI, RMSEA).
